app_store.name: TallyPitch: Cricket Scorer
app_store.subtitle: Club Leagues & Live Scoring
app_store.promotional_text: Score club cricket matches ball-by-ball with instant rollback, automated Net Run Rate tables, and broadcast overlays. Built for grassroots cricket without popup ads.
app_store.description:
TallyPitch is the grassroots cricket scoring and league platform built for club scorers, tournament organizers, and local players.

Never miss another delivery on the field. TallyPitch gives you a fast, distraction-free scoring keypad with zero full-screen pop-up ads between overs, offline-first reliability when ground signals drop, and instant in-memory rollback undo.

WHAT YOU GET:
- Live Ball-by-Ball Scoring: High-contrast keypad with automatic odd-run strike rotation, over-end strike flip, and dismissal tracking.
- 0ms Rollback Undo: Miskeyed a delivery under pressure? Restore exact previous match states, scores, and striker strike with one tap.
- Offline-First Resilience: Scores save locally in memory so rural grounds with spotty cellular coverage never lose an innings.
- Automated ICC Net Run Rate (NRR): Dynamic league standings calculate runs and overs scored versus conceded in real time.
- Tournament Scheduling: Multi-stage pool formats (Group A/B) and automated round-robin fixture generation.
- Free Broadcast Overlays: Built-in OBS and vMix lower-third ticker URL included for community live streams.
- Digital Scorecards: ICC-standard scorecards with batting strike rates, bowling economy, fall-of-wickets timeline, and live commentary.
- Player Career Records: Digital player profiles tracking career runs, averages, wickets, best bowling, and milestone badges.

Built for clubs and tournaments who value speed, accuracy, and transparent cricket.
